settings.label: Shadow threshold (percent of the Otsu value)
settings.help: Pixels darker than this percentage of the image's Otsu value are taken as shadow between grains and ignored. Higher: more of the image is treated as shadow; lower: less.

authors.source: PebbleCountsAuto.py -otsu_threshold: no default; the program asks for it on screen at each run

settings.differs_because: PebbleMapper runs without anyone at the screen, so a value must be given; 50 is PebbleMapper's choice and was not measured against other values.

settings.label: Minimum grain area
settings.help: Grains smaller than this area are removed when the grain mask is cleaned. Higher: small grains and specks are dropped.

authors.source: PebbleCountsAuto.py help: 10 for about 1 mm per pixel, 20 for images finer than 0.8 mm per pixel

settings.differs_because: kept at the program's default of 10; PebbleMapper's photographs are usually finer than 0.8 mm per pixel, for which the authors advise 20. Not yet measured here.

settings.label: Shortest grain kept (b-axis)
settings.help: Grains whose b-axis is shorter than this many pixels are not counted. Higher: small grains are not counted.

settings.label: Largest overlap between neighbouring ellipses
settings.help: A grain whose fitted ellipse overlaps a neighbour's by more than this percentage is treated as suspect and removed. Higher: more grains kept, some of them doubtful.

settings.label: Largest misfit between ellipse and grain
settings.help: A grain whose mask differs from its fitted ellipse by more than this percentage is treated as suspect and removed. Higher: more irregular grains kept.

settings.label: First denoising strength
settings.help: Strength of the first non-local-means filtering of colour. Higher: smoother image, fewer false edges, fine detail lost.

settings.label: Top-hat edge percentile
settings.help: The top percentile of the top-hat filter taken as grain edges. Higher: only the strongest edges are kept, so grains merge more often.

settings.label: Sobel edge percentile
settings.help: The top percentile of the Sobel filter taken as grain edges. Higher: only the strongest edges are kept, so grains merge more often.

settings.label: Canny edge smoothing (sigma)
settings.help: Smoothing of the Canny edge detection. Higher: fewer, smoother edges, so grains merge more often.

fixed.label: Ortho mode
fixed.reason: it needs choices made on screen; an ortho is processed as a photograph, whole, at its pixel size.

fixed.label: Sand mask and colour mask
fixed.reason: the program draws them interactively on screen; PebbleMapper answers 'no'.

fixed.label: Processor
fixed.reason: PebbleCountsAuto does not use the graphics card.
